desc: Derive the gap transformation: operation on pieces i..i+3 swaps gaps d_i and d_{i+2} (verified with sample 1: (4,2,3)→(3,2,4)), so same-parity gap indices are freely permutable.
Express total sum S = N*x_1 + Σ d_j*(N-j); x_1 and x_N are invariant (only middle pieces i+1, i+2 ever move).
Prove reachability: distance-2 swaps are adjacent transpositions within each parity class's path, generating the full symmetric group on each class.

Implement: read N, X; compute gaps; split by parity of 1-based index j; sort each class ascending; assign to positions of that class in ascending j (smallest gap to largest weight, per rearrangement inequality); compute S = N*X[0] + Σ (N-j)*d_j; print.
Validate against samples (21, 41 — both confirmed by hand) and edge cases (N=4, single-element parity class, coordinates up to 1e12 — Python ints handle it).
Write final solution with sys.stdin.buffer fast I/O, O(N log N), enclosed in code delimiters.
